Headquarters: Remote - Tamil Nadu, India

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a Hybrid, Chennai role, reporting to the Regional Sales Director in the Commercial Sales department. You will join a global group of professionals passionate about delighting customers and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future as the world leader in cloud security. As a key member of the Sales and Go-to-Market team, you will demonstrate the power and agility of cloud transformation while nurturing trusted partnerships to achieve shared success.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Understand and solve customer pain points through our unique value proposition while educating key decision-makers on inspiring technology

• Act as the GM of your business by creating strategic success plans that include coverage, target prospects, and marketing campaigns

• Implement world-class sales methodologies to consistently overachieve on quarterly and annual revenue goals

• Collaborate with Sales Engineers to ensure the delivery of both business and technical value

• Partner with the channel ecosystem to create joint plans, build pipeline, and lead opportunities to closure

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 8+ years of sales experience with a consistent track record of meeting revenue quotas, including 4+ years selling specifically to the commercial segment

• Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field

• Progressive selling experience engaging with accounts and building relationships at the C-level

• Experience working with channel partners to create joint plans and lead opportunities to closure

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience demonstrating the business value of AI-driven security architectures or leveraging AI productivity platforms to optimize commercial sales pipelines

• Experience selling security, SaaS, or software solutions

• A history of career over-achievement, consistently ranking in the top 10% of your organization

Job Description: Business Analyst 
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, enhancing operational efficiency, and collaborating with stakeholders to drive business success. This role involves working closely with technical teams, business leaders, and end-users to bridge the gap between technology and business objectives. 
Mode: [On-site]

923ab6d371439ad1.description: All our customers start their Wise journey by going through customer verification. We do this to keep our customers money safe and to prevent criminals from using our products for illegal activities. We in Personal Onboarding Verification are building and running the global KYC (Know Your Customer) system that provides the functionality to verify our customers. This system needs to keep up with increasingly sophisticated methods of criminals, but do it in a way to keep our product convenient and cheap for customers. In addition to building global KYC features, our team also builds the framework for our Regional Teams to localize the verification experience. Our colleagues in Regional Teams extend the system with local verification vendors, collect documents specific to the country and implement any other checks that the local regulations mandate. To succeed, our team needs to implement a system that keeps up with state of the art technology, enables several teams to contribute while keeping complexity and load manageable and has the data and observability to analyse our flows and prove they work according to regulations. Team you will be working with: Youll join our Personal Onboarding Verification team - a diverse, cross-functional group passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions We bring together engineering disciplines across the stack, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences Our team is responsible for the critical verification journey that consumers complete before using Wises products We own the entire verification lifecycle - from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring We operate with high autonomy, make data-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. 92320ef5e9db7c04.description: Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable. AI-driven supply chain innovations reduce logistics costs by 15%+, inventory by 35%+, and improve service efficiency by 65%+. Companies prioritize AI-enabled automation as the key enabler for customer experience, sustainability, and resilience. Some of the world's largest shippers use it to track billions of dollars of freight every day. This is not a PM support role. You'll work hands-on with data, build your own prototypes, talk directly with enterprise customers, and partner with engineering and design to ship features that improve adoption, retention and tracking quality. The role sits where supply chain operations meet modern software product development, and you'll need both. What you'll be doing Product Ownership & Outcomes - Own product outcomes for one or more OTR modes (Truckload, LTL, Parcel or Last Mile), including tracking quality, ETA accuracy and carrier coverage. - Find friction points and adoption gaps using usage data, customer interviews and feedback from Customer Success and Sales. - Build and prioritize a backlog that measurably improves customer stickiness, and bring well-reasoned prioritization recommendations to roadmap planning. Data & AI-Assisted Product Development - Write your own SQL to explore feature usage, tracking performance and customer behavior, without waiting on an analyst. - Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor and similar) to build working prototypes, internal tools and quick analyses that make a requirement concrete before engineering picks it up. - Turn quantitative findings into clear product hypotheses and actionable backlog items. - Partner with Data Science and Engineering on instrumentation and event tracking. Customer Engagement - Run discovery sessions and join onboarding calls, QBRs and support escalations to understand shipper and carrier workflows firsthand. - Work with Customer Success Managers to surface systemic product gaps and recurring pain points. - Cross-Functional Execution - Work with Engineering and Design through scoping, development and post-launch monitoring, partnering directly with squads across time zones. - Support Product Marketing with onboarding materials, release notes and adoption playbooks. - Associate Product Manager: 24 years in product management or a related role. Strong BA, analyst, solutions or implementation backgrounds in logistics tech are welcome. - Product Manager: 5+ years, including end-to-end ownership of a product area and a track record of shipping with measurable business impact. Practical experience in supply chain or logistics. You understand shipper pain points, carrier dynamics and how freight moves day to day. .

9240a3c5fdba67e8.description: About MechMind RoboticsMechMind Robotics is a global leader in industrial 3D vision and AIpowered robotics software. Our technology enables manufacturers, logistics providers, and automation integrators to deploy intelligent robotic systems that see, decide, and act with precision. With a rapidly growing footprint in India, we are expanding our regional leadership team to capture the significant automation demand in the region's electronics manufacturing, home appliance, automotive, and metal processing corridors.Position SummaryThe Sales Manager, India is a fullcycle enterprise sales role for a technically fluent, marketsavvy professional who thrives on building business from the ground up. Based in Bengaluru or Chennai with flexibility for remote customer engagement, you will own the complete sales lifecycle  from strategic territory planning and cold prospecting to technical solution design, negotiation, and deal closure  across electronics manufacturing (EMS), home appliance, automotive Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers, OEMs, ODMs, and system integrators.This is not a maintenance role. You will be expected to open new accounts, win competitive evaluations, and establish MechMind as the preferred 3D vision partner in one of India's most dynamic industrial zones. High performers will have the opportunity to shape regional strategy and build a local team as the territory scales.What You'll DoOwn the Territory: Strategically plan and execute sales activities across India, with primary focus on Southern India, managing the full sales cycle from lead generation to contract closure to achieve aggressive regional growth targets.Hunt & Land Key Accounts: Independently prospect, qualify, and close new business with electronics manufacturing leaders, home appliance brands, automotive Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers, metal processing leaders, OEMs, ODMs, and automation integrators  with minimal supervision.Be the Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage directly with Engineering, Operations, and Plant Management to understand automation challenges, architect customerspecific 3D vision and AI robotics solutions  including robotic guidance, precision assembly, inline quality inspection (AOI), and logistics sorting  and articulate clear ROI.Drive Quality & Inspection Solutions: Identify highvolume AOI and inline 3D inspection opportunities in electronics assembly and appliance manufacturing, where defect reduction, throughput optimization, and zerodefect delivery are critical KPIs.Drive Account Expansion: Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts; identify upsell and crosssell opportunities, ensure retention, and nurture longterm strategic partnerships.Align Internal Resources: Collaborate closely with internal engineering, applications, and support teams to scope, prototype, and deliver solutions that win technical evaluations.Read the Market: Continuously monitor Southern India industrial trends, electronics supply chain shifts, home appliance manufacturing dynamics, automotive sector developments, and competitor movements to uncover whitespace opportunities and preempt risks.Represent the Brand: Lead regional presence at trade shows, industry events, and customerfacing activities to build brand authority and generate qualified pipeline.Be Based in Bengaluru or Chennai: Operate from our regional hub in Bengaluru or Chennai to ensure strong local presence, rapid customer response, and effective coordination with headquarters and regional partners.Build for Scale: Provide structured feedback to global leadership on India market signals, pricing dynamics, and productmarket fit to inform broader regional strategy.What We're Looking ForBachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical field  you understand how automation systems work at a component level.5+ years of fullcycle sales experience in industrial automation, machine vision, robotics, or closely related industrial technologies, with a demonstrable track record of new business development (not just account maintenance). Prior experience in electronics assembly, home appliance manufacturing, or precision assembly is highly preferred.Proven ability to prospect and close independently  you are comfortable with cold outreach, onsite technical presentations, and navigating complex, multistakeholder buying committees in multinational manufacturing environments.Strong technical fluency in automation and machine vision solutions; you can hold your own in discussions with engineers and translate technical capabilities into business value.Highly selfmotivated, targetdriven, and energized by ambiguity  you perform best when you're building something, not inheriting it.Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in Hindi and English; ability to operate seamlessly across Indian industrial culture and global corporate standards. Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a strong plus, given the high concentration of Chinese and Taiwanese manufacturers in Southern India.Willingness to travel frequently throughout India (with primary focus on Southern industrial zones).What Makes This Role UniqueYou'll own a market, not just a quota  India is a priority growth region with immediate demand from electronics and home appliance manufacturing hubs in the South.You'll sell technology that wins on merit  cuttingedge 3D vision and AI robotics with demonstrable technical differentiation, not commodity hardware.You'll build the playbook  this is an earlystage regional buildout; your wins will define how MechMind scales in India.Direct line to global leadership  your market insights will shape product roadmap, pricing strategy, and regional investment decisions.

927b1a374c780ac0.description:
The short version: Who we’re looking for: A product associate who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage - and operates in an AI-native way to build and deliver outcomes. You’re someone who is equally comfortable structuring ambiguous problems and getting your hands dirty building and testing solutions, with a strong bias toward action and real-world validation.

What the role is about: At Kraftshala, product sits at the intersection of student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. You will identify high-impact problems across these areas and take them from idea to outcome. A defining part of this role is the ability to translate ideas into working solutions quickly- using AI-assisted prototyping, APIs, and lightweight systems to test, iterate, and refine before scaling with engineering.

About us: Kraftshala is India’s largest higher-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains. We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestle, and Performics.

The detailed version:  As a product associate at Kraftshala, you will own high-impact problems across students, internal teams (admissions, sales, placements, operations, marketing), and external users. You will operate across the full lifecycle- from problem identification and structuring to solution design, execution, and measurable outcomes. A core expectation in this role is the ability to increase your execution leverage- using AI-assisted prototyping, LLM integrations, and modular systems to move from idea to usable output quickly, validate in real contexts, and refine before scaling.

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Problem discovery & structuring: Identify and prioritize high-impact problems across student journeys, revenue funnels, and internal workflows. 
2. Solution design with business context: Design solutions grounded in user needs, operational constraints, and business impact. 
3. AI-assisted prototyping & rapid build: Use AI-assisted prototyping, prompt engineering, and tools (e.g., Cursor, Replit, Claude, Copilot) to build MVPs, workflows, or automations quickly. 
4. Execution & delivery with engineering: Work with engineering to productionize and scale validated solutions.
5. Workflow automation & systems improvement: Build and improve internal tools, AI-in-the-loop workflows, and integrations to reduce manual effort and increase efficiency. 
6. Iteration, experimentation & impact ownership: Run tight build-measure-learn loops and continuously refine solutions. 

Why you should apply: 

1. You’ll get the opportunity to work across multiple high-stakes problem areas.
2. You will operate with high autonomy and faster execution cycles, moving beyond documentation-heavy product work into actually building, testing, and validating solutions yourself.
3. This role enables you to develop an AI-native way of working - where you can prototype quickly, automate workflows, and run rapid experiments instead of waiting on long development cycles.

Selection process: As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30-60 minutes. 

1. Setting expectations: This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
2. Technical exercise: This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role.
3. Conversation 1: This will be a detailed assessment review conversation to go over your submission for the technical exercise along with other competencies required for the role.
4. Conversation 2: A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode. 
5. Extending an offer: If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.

Monthly outcomes:

Month 1:
1. Build strong understanding of users, systems, and business priorities.
2. Identify and validate at least 2 meaningful problem areas.
3. Ship at least one improvement (feature, workflow, or automation).

Month 2:
1. Own planning and alignment with engineering.
2. Translate validated problems into clear solutions.
3. Prototype and test before scaling.
4. Roll out at least one meaningful system improvement.

Month 3+:
1. Deliver 2–3 high-impact initiatives per quarter.
2. Contribute to and progressively take ownership of a problem-led roadmap.
3. Improve execution speed through better systems and iteration loops.
4. Become a trusted problem solver for cross-functional teams.

If you’re looking for a role where you can own meaningful problems, build quickly, and see the impact of your work end-to-end, this is the role for you.
